verdict.rationale: Working Copy is an iOS git client with richly documented on-device commit and push. The docs cover committing from the Status tab, staging individual hunks, amend, separate offline commit and later push, and Auto-Sync that commits, pulls and pushes. SSH, HTTPS and Secure Enclave keys cover authentication. A community user independently confirms they pull, edit and push from the iOS app while commuting.

support.subject: As a developer, I can commit and push changes directly from my device

citations.quote: you can commit them to the repository with a button on the Status tab.
Because Commit and Push are distinct actions you can Commit while offline and Push once you get back online.
_Auto-Sync_ does all of this for you, committing, pulling and pushing whenever changes are detected.
uses the iOS app to pull, edit and push while commuting.
